scope: Read-only argument and reference-assisted diagnosis; not a new deployed method.
general_claims: Improving utility alone does not generally repair an incorrect admissible region.
Authorization-preserving processing needs both safety and useful feasible output.
Certificates are conditional on semantic coverage and correct state-wise functions.
An empirical representation comparison cannot establish superiority to a programming language.
confirmation_needed: Freeze a deployable semantic-validation mechanism before any confirmatory experiment.
Use all planned questions, matched public input, tools, model configurations and resource budgets.
Report unsafe approval, false refusal, invalid generation, useful completion and cost jointly.
Use held-out contract families and new random catalogues; reuse no discovery answers.
Give strong Python controls the same semantic information and validation resources.
Retain full paired results, including reversals and ties.
